name: Lady Wolf Moon Megaways

features.name: Megaways refills
features.description: Changing ways with a refill feature for consecutive wins.

features.name: Wheel of Fortune
features.description: Decides the number of free spins and the round multiplier.

review:
The moonlit wolf on a Megaways grid, now with refills that can chain several wins from one spin. Wilds carry 2x multipliers.

Free spins are set by a Wheel of Fortune that decides both the number of spins and a multiplier for the whole round, so each bonus starts differently. This one's rated very high volatility – a big jump from the original's medium – with a 6,000x max and 96.75% RTP. Free spins about once every 136 spins.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 136 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
